model: Horizon Outdoor Air Unit, Tracer UC600 program V12
applies_to: Trane Horizon outdoor air units (cabinets OAB, OAD, OAG, OAK, OAN) with the Tracer UC600 controller running Horizon program version 12.
summary: Trane Horizon outdoor air units are controlled by a Tracer UC600 that talks BACnet MS/TP or BACnet IP. This list covers program V12: occupancy and heat/cool mode requests, BAS inputs for space and outdoor conditions, temperature, humidity, airflow, static pressure and CO2 setpoints, supply and exhaust fan, damper, compressor, condenser fan, heat pump, reheat and energy wheel status and commands, refrigerant leak detection inputs and the diagnostic BVs. Which points exist depends on unit type and options.
notes: Points come from the guide's complete points list (Tables 33-39) plus the diagnostic BVs that are only printed in the diagnostics table (Table 32).
Not all points exist on every unit; availability depends on equipment type, control program type and options.
Multistate state texts are given where the guide prints a clean list; for the other MVs (mode status, source and fan-type objects) see Table 39 of the guide.
BI 24 and BI 25 (refrigerant leak detection inputs) are footnoted in the guide.
Our separate "Tracer UC600 Packaged Outdoor Air Unit" list (BAS-SVP18E) covers the older program; this V12 guide adds about 150 objects.

integration.summary: Write the occupancy request and heat/cool mode request, the occupied or discharge setpoints and, where used, BAS values for space temperature, humidity, CO2 and static pressure. Read operating mode status, discharge air temperature and the lockout/diagnostic BVs; reset manual diagnostics with Alarm Reset.
integration.enable: BV 59 AUTO/STOP stops the unit from the network (1 = Stop) and releases it (0 = Auto). Occupancy Request (MV 1) and Heat Cool Mode Request (MV 3) drive normal operation.
integration.remote_sensors: The BAS can write Space Temperature BAS (AV 20), Space Temperature Setpoint BAS (AV 25), Space Humidity BAS (AV 8), Space CO2 Concentration BAS (AV 42), Space Static Pressure BAS (AV 73), Duct Static Pressure BAS (AV 64), Outdoor Air Temperature BAS (AV 75), Outdoor Air Humidity BAS (AV 81) and Discharge Air Temperature Setpoint BAS (AV 67); the guide ties each to the matching control program type.
setup: The Tracer UC600 supports BACnet MS/TP and BACnet IP; the device ID examples are in the guide (Tables 5-7).
Check the program revision first: the guide lists BACnet points that report the program version (Table 2).
gotchas: Point availability depends on equipment type (DX, ASHP, WSHP, chilled water), program control type and options.
Manual-reset diagnostics stay latched until Alarm Reset (BV 16) is written; auto-reset ones clear on their own.
Diagnostic: Fire Shutdown (BV 8) is written by the BAS and shuts the unit down until it returns to normal.
